data.name: Tailbreak
data.detailed_description:
A new dinosaur-blasting adventure is in town!

Serving as a follow-up to Railbreak and as a retelling of the hit DINOBREAK, Tailbreak evolves the arcade on-rails shooter experience from mere resurrection to pleasingly primal for up to two players!

Weapons and mechanics have been intensified; starting with just a handgun, you’ll need to make tough choices about your sub-weapons and juggle pick-ups with the new item system.  Do you dedicate an item slot to a grenade or a healing item?  Do you stick with your trusty machine gun, or do you switch it up with a heavy rifle?  

With new and realistic lighting utilizing Unreal Engine 5.7, Cypress Ridge looks more sinister and desolate than ever before.  A new, fully-voiced, six-act Story mode tells the plight of heroines Alex and Rin as they struggle to survive the events of DINOBREAK without becoming dino food.  The Arrange mode brings custom handguns and upgradable sub-weapons to the fray for something a little zanier, while the Mutation Matrix randomizes the game’s encounters and items for an unpredictable experience every play-through!

More bonus modes and features await as you take on nature’s ancient beasts on the safari of a lifetime in Tailbreak! Even better, you can invite the undead to the party in all bonus modes with the choice of facing dinosaurs, zombies, or a mix of the two!

Features:

  • NEW Item System:  Pick up healing items, ammo, and more, but be careful: you can only hold two at a time!  Will you prioritize the extra firepower of a grenade, or will you hold onto a precious, life-restoring sprout for a rainy day?

  • Fierce Firepower:  Blast away with both returning and new weapons.  Carefully manage your sub-weapon ammo, or you may find yourself up dino creek without a paddle!  In Arrange mode, choose between handguns with different effects, and level up your sub-weapons to make them more powerful.

  • Deliciously Cheesy:  Enjoy a new story where lead characters Alex and Rin check out the coolest new game in Cypress Ridge Arcade – Tailbreak! It’s all about their search for safety in a city ravaged by raptors.  All six acts feature full voice acting with hysterical banter and the crazy camp you’d expect in your favorite B-movie!

  • Gameplay Galore:  Bonus modes like Score Attack, Arrange Mode, and Mutation Matrix add additional depth and extra replayability to the game.  Plus, all content can be experienced solo or in local co-op play with a friend! And don't forget, outside of the Story Mode experience you can choose to face the ruthless dinosaurs, terrifying zombies, or a mixture of the two!

  • Scarily Beautiful:  The world of Cypress Ridge comes to life whether you’re blasting through a restaurant or sulking through dark caverns thanks to the power of cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5.7, which brings stunning ray traced lighting to the varied, highly-detailed environments you’ll flee through during your exploits.

data.short_description: Dinosaurs return in this on-rails action shooter with a feral twist!
data.reviews:
“The Mutation Matrix is perhaps the most interesting feature for players who want unpredictability. By randomising encounters and items, it ensures that subsequent playthroughs do not necessarily unfold as expected.”
4/5 – Game Critix

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 3000 Series or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 4000 Series or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Hardware

content_descriptors.notes: Tailbreak is an action packed arcade shooter with blood, gore, and adult language. It involves combat against monsters and in some rare cases, zombies.
